title: Recognition baseline manifest
description: Single machine-readable record of the legacy-DSP recognition baseline (E14-R02, ADR 0354). Carries no raw audio: only a corpus identity hash/count, the app commit and configuration measured, and per-metric value+n+sourceFile+command evidence. Enforced by hand-written validation in tool/benchmarks/recognition_baseline_manifest.dart (no schema-library dependency, ADR 0354 D8) rather than by a generic JSON-Schema library.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema contract version. The checker rejects any other value.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp the manifest's data was assembled, written by hand into this file. The generator never calls a clock (ADR 0354 D5) — this value is the only source of a timestamp anywhere in the rendered index.

appCommit.description: App commit the measured numbers were produced at.

appCommitNote.description: Required free-text note distinguishing which commit produced which number when more than one commit is involved (e.g. a later commit retracting an earlier one). Never empty — a manifest with a single, wholly consistent commit still states that explicitly.

models.description: ML weights that participated in the measured configuration. Empty when the configuration used none (ADR 0354 D7) — see modelsRationale.

modelsRationale.description: Required and non-empty when "models" is empty (ADR 0354 D7): explains why no model weight participated, so an empty list reads as a stated fact rather than an omission. Optional when "models" is non-empty.

oneOf.description: models is non-empty: modelsRationale is not required.
models is empty: modelsRationale is required (ADR 0354 D7).

corpusId.description: Repository-relative identifier of the corpus directory (e.g. "ml/data/klangio"). The corpus itself is never committed (ADR 0354 D1).

strumRefiner.description: null when the measurement used the ClipAnalyzer default (no strum refiner model).

n.description: Count of elements the value was measured over. n=0 is never valid (ADR 0354 D6, D2): a metric with nothing behind it is not measured.

oneOf.description: measured: metrics required, notMeasuredReason forbidden (ADR 0354 D3).
not-measured: notMeasuredReason required, metrics forbidden (ADR 0354 D3).

retracted.description: Always true: BPM is a retracted claim on this corpus (ADR 0354 D4), never an active metric block. A future round that CAN measure BPM adds a new block, it does not flip this one.
